statusDetail: The EEA/UK geographic HTTP 403 gate allowed a complete audit of the delivered notice but blocked the representative Yahoo News reading flow and normal robots/sitemap/indexing signals.

page.notes: From this audit location every tested news.yahoo.co.jp path, including robots.txt and sitemap.xml, returned the same bilingual EEA/UK access notice with HTTP 403. Coverage therefore represents the delivered gate page, not Yahoo News article/listing/search templates.

paths.description: Delivered desktop EEA/UK geographic access notice; represents the only reachable template from this region.
Narrow/reflowed form-factor condition for the delivered notice.
Unknown-path/error-state probe; the geographic gate intercepted it with the same notice.

findings.summary: The notice ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is pixel-identical in palette to the light capture; the computed probe reports colorScheme "normal" and the white surface remains unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare `color-scheme: light dark` and use preference-aware surface, text, link, and border colors as described by the dark-mode guidance.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is disabled and many links have undersized activation areas.
findings.evidence: axe reports a critical meta-viewport violation for `user-scalable=no`. The 360 px target probe measures many links at only 14–24 px high, including footer links at 14 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove `user-scalable=no`; preserve reflow at zoom and give standalone links a target area near 44×44 CSS px through padding or spacing without changing inline text-link semantics.

findings.summary: Touch targets are too short even though keyboard focus remains visible.
findings.evidence: At 360×800, the mobile probe reports service links at 21 px high and footer links at 14 px high; focused anchors use only the browser’s 1 px auto outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target padding/spacing for standalone navigation links and add a clearly visible `:focus-visible` treatment while retaining non-hover affordances.

findings.summary: The small static notice misses the good LCP threshold in the captured load.
findings.evidence: The trace summary records FCP/LCP at 2885 ms. The HAR shows the 403 document taking 2181 ms and five parser-inserted stylesheets before the page is fully styled.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce document latency, inline the tiny critical styles for this access notice, and defer or consolidate non-critical stylesheet/font work.

findings.summary: Five parser-blocking stylesheets and an icon font delay a 99-element static document.
findings.evidence: The HAR summary identifies five parser-inserted stylesheet candidates and a 19,161-byte icon font; the DOM confirms these are ordinary stylesheet links without conditional loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate and inline only critical notice-page CSS, remove unused icon-font delivery, and load any remaining non-critical styles without extending the critical chain.

findings.summary: Blue links do not meet WCAG AA contrast against white.
findings.evidence: axe reports 21 affected nodes. Link contrast is 4.04:1 or 4.17:1 where 4.5:1 is required, including the primary help and alternative-service links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a darker link color that reaches at least 4.5:1 in every link style and verify normal, visited, hover, focus, and forced-color states.

findings.summary: The document has no H1 and nests the contentinfo landmark inside main.
findings.evidence: axe reports `page-has-heading-one` and `landmark-contentinfo-is-top-level`. The DOM heading sequence starts at H3, then moves to H2.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the notice title the single H1, arrange subsequent headings hierarchically, and move the footer outside `<main>`.

findings.summary: The only image is oversized and lacks an intrinsic height.
findings.evidence: The image audit finds the logo’s 1933 px natural width displayed at 170 px, no height attribute, no srcset, and legacy PNG delivery. The page recorded a small CLS of 0.0159.
findings.suggestedFix: Export a right-sized WebP/AVIF or compact SVG logo, provide responsive sources if needed, and set both intrinsic width and height.

findings.summary: The notice has a descriptive title but no meta description.
findings.evidence: The DOM and platform probe both report no `meta[name="description"]`.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise Japanese/English-aware meta description that explains the regional availability notice and available alternatives.

findings.summary: The public notice exposes no share-preview or structured metadata.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe finds zero Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks despite the page containing dated notice articles.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter preview fields and, if treating this as a published notice, matching schema.org Article or WebPage JSON-LD.

findings.summary: The geographic-gate response omits several baseline browser security headers.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirms HTTPS and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, but finds no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, a restrictive CSP (including `frame-ancestors`), a privacy-preserving Referrer-Policy, and a minimal Permissions-Policy on the gate response.

findings.summary: The bilingual Japanese/English document does not declare its language.
findings.evidence: Both the DOM and axe report that `<html>` has no `lang`; the English article also has no local language annotation.
findings.suggestedFix: Set `<html lang="ja">` and wrap the English section in an element with `lang="en"`; add `dir` only where direction differs.

findings.summary: The logo transfers far more source pixels than its rendered size needs.
findings.evidence: The image primitive reports a 1933 px PNG rendered at 170 px, with no srcset or modern format. It transfers 13,018 bytes on a 73,701-byte page.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a correctly sized modern-format asset (or SVG) and declare responsive/intrinsic dimensions.

taskList.title: Restore browser-enforced security headers on the geographic-gate response
Restore zoom, enlarge standalone targets, and strengthen focus treatment
Fix link contrast and repair heading/landmark semantics
Declare Japanese and English language boundaries
Reduce gate-page latency and collapse the render-blocking CSS/font chain
Right-size the logo and declare both intrinsic dimensions
Add description and accurate share metadata to the access notice
